name: le-harnais distribution

tiers.A_portable_core: the `lh` binary (default-members, no candle/CUDA). Cross-compiles to every target; covers the whole mission (inference delegated to ollama/openai-compat). Build: dist/build-matrix.sh
tiers.B_native_serve: the OPTIONAL `lh-serve` candle server. Built natively per target (never cross-compiled). Optional: ollama is the recommended, faster generation path.

logic_backend_capability.note: Uniform by construction across ALL targets. sql=bundled sqlite (pure Rust, travels with the binary); prolog=scryer (bundled, pure Rust); clingo/z3/lean SHELL OUT (no C-linking) so they are RUNTIME PATH deps.
logic_backend_capability.inference: ollama or an openai-compat endpoint on the target

lh-linux-x86_64.standalone: verified — links only libc/libm/libgcc_s; runs `--version` and bundled prolog/sql verify outside the repo with no model

lh-linux-arm64.note: cross-built (aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu via `cross`, rootless flag). Verified ELF aarch64. This is ALSO the DGX Spark core binary.

lh-macos-arm64.note: build on a Mac via build-macos.sh (cannot cross-build from Linux)

lh-serve-dgx-spark-cuda.note: build ON the Spark (Blackwell GB10, sm_121); cross-compiling CUDA for arm64 is impractical

lh-serve-macos-arm64-metal.note: build on the Mac: cargo build -p lh-serve --features metal

models.delivery: Hugging Face Hub (renaudb1999/le-harnais-*); fetch with models/fetch_models.sh

tools.note: Bundled companion BINARIES (linux-x86_64) + agent skills; each binary dir has build.sh for macOS arm64 / linux arm64.

datasets.note: Versioned, checksummed backup of the gitignored datasets/*.jsonl (17 files, 5712 rows). Restore: tar xzf ... -C datasets/.

env.check: check-env.sh (--json) — REQUIRED/LOGIC/TOOLS doctor; exit code = missing required count
env.install_ollama: install-ollama.sh [--pull MODEL] — install the generation backend per-OS
env.skill: .claude/skills/dist-doctor/SKILL.md — agent entry point for the two scripts

notes: Weights are NOT in the tarball — they live in per-model HF repos.
HF upload needs a WRITE token (cached token is read-only): models/upload_to_hf.py.
macOS arm64 binary is built on the user's Mac (build-macos.sh); lh needs only Rust to build.
Companion tool binaries are linux-x86_64; rebuild per-platform via tools/<tool>/build.sh.
datasets/*.jsonl are gitignored — dist/datasets/ is their versioned backup.
